mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4.5% in prior month fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (low UNRATE and high PAYEMS growth) signals wage inflation risks, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, high residential construction (HOUST) and strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate overheating demand, triggering inflation concerns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: High HOUST and RSAFS during late-cycle expansion fail to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for demand indicators.

mechanism_narrative: Higher residential construction (HOUST) reflects strong housing demand and consumer confidence, supporting economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during demand expansion.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1400 fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a very tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation risks, leading to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) combined with robust GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates rapid economic expansion, raising inflation concerns and policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of INDPRO > 102.0 and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, strong industrial production (INDPRO) signals rebounding manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100 during post-recession recovery fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
